import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    # Fix island label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'biscoe': 'Biscoe'})
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric, handling commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    # Fix out-of-range body_mass_g (3650000 -> 3650)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    # Convert year to numeric
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    result = {}
    for species, group in df.groupby('species'):
        result[species] = group['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return result
